source_title: Freddy's partners with The Hershey Company for new limited-time offers and brings back French Onion Steakburger - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
WICHITA, Kan. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Freddy's Frozen Custard & SteakburgersÂ® announced today the brand's partnership with The Hershey Company for three new frozen custard treats, and the return of its French Onion Steakburger starting Wednesday, Nov. 4, through Tuesday, Jan. 5. The limited-time offers will be available to order at participating Freddy's locations nationwide via drive-thru, in-restaurant dining, and pickup or delivery through the Freddy's mobile app and at https://freddys.com . Guests who visit Freddy's during this promotional period will receive a special offer: buy two tickets and get two tickets free for the movie Hershey , which releases in theaters nationwide on Wednesday, Nov. 25.
French Onion Steakburger : Two steakburger patties with melted Swiss cheese, grilled onions and crispy onions. Served on a toasted bun with French Onion aioli.
Peanut Butter Blossom Cookie Concrete : With a flavor profile inspired by the classic holiday peanut butter blossom cookies, this concrete features vanilla frozen custard blended with cookie dough and REESE'S Peanut Butter Sauce, garnished with HERSHEY'S Chocolate Chips.
HEATH Caramel Cheesecake Concrete : Vanilla frozen custard blended with a double portion of HEATH Toffee, caramel sauce and cheesecake. Topped with whipped cream and cinnamon streusel.
HERSHEY'S Snowfall Sundae : Vanilla frozen custard topped with HERSHEY'S Chocolate Sauce, marshmallow sauce and HERSHEY'S Chocolate Chips. Topped with whipped cream and a cherry.
"We're excited to be teaming up with The Hershey Company to introduce new menu items that bring together classic, decadent flavors with the quality our guests expect from Freddy's," said Rick Petralia, Executive Chef and VP of Training & Innovation. "These HERSHEY'S-inspired treats offer fresh takes on the timeless combinations of chocolate, peanut butter and caramel, while the return of our French Onion Steakburger gives guests the opportunity to enjoy a savory fan favorite. It's a lineup designed to celebrate the flavors our guests love while giving them something new to discover at Freddy's."
Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers is a leading fast-casual franchise concept with over 600 locations across the United States and Canada. Founded in Wichita, Kansas, in 2002, the brand offers a unique combination of cooked-to-order steakburgers, all-beef hot dogs, shoestring fries and other savory items along with freshly churned frozen custard treats. Known for operating the Freddy's Way, Guests experience genuine hospitality and food prepared fresh with premium ingredients. This signature approach has fueled Freddy's ongoing growth throughout the U.S. and garnered national recognition from industry-leading rankings, including being named No. 6 on Fast Casual's Top 100 Movers + Shakers, No. 85 on Entrepreneur's Franchise 500, and No. 60 on Technomic's Top 500. For more on Freddy's, visit the Newsroom and follow us on Facebook and Instagram . For more information about development opportunities, visit https://freddysfranchising.com/ .
